data.name: Eve
data.message: Hi Diana, doing engine alignment here

data.name: Alice
data.message: Just finishing my scan, then heading to electrical.

data.name: Diana
data.message: I have a task in electrical too, let's go together!

data.name: Bob
data.message: Just finished calibrating, heading to security for cameras. Want to buddy up?

I found Alice's body in electrical. I came from weapons through security into electrical, and when I arrived, Diana was already in the room with the body. I didn't see anyone else on my route. Diana, you'll need to explain what you were doing there — you're my prime suspect right now unless someone else can vouch for your movements.

I was in upper engine at the start, then moved to oxygen to do my task. I saw Diana at tick 1 in upper engine — she had come from oxygen — and at tick 2 she left upper engine heading toward medbay.

So Diana's path was oxygen -> upper_engine -> medbay. From medbay she could potentially reach electrical, but that's a stretch in the timing. Frank, when exactly did you find the body? If Diana went medbay -> electrical, she could have arrived there shortly before you did.

I can't fully confirm or clear Diana, but her movements are at least consistent with what Frank described — she was heading in that general direction. I'd like to hear Diana's account before voting.

Eve has my early route perfectly correct. I went oxygen -> upper engine -> medbay. In medbay, I actually saw Alice, and she headed into electrical just ahead of me. 

When I followed her into electrical, she was already dead on the floor. More importantly, I saw Bob leaving electrical heading towards security right as I was walking in! I was standing there in shock, just about to hit the report button, when Frank walked in. 

Frank, you said you came from security and didn't see anyone? That's impossible unless Bob slipped past you, or you're lying. I literally saw Bob leaving electrical towards security right after Alice died. It has to be Bob.

Diana is straight-up lying about me. Let me give my actual route: I started in medbay, did some work there, then moved to electrical. I arrived in electrical at tick 5 — and Diana was already there standing over Alice's body. I did NOT come from electrical heading to security. After seeing Diana with the body, I went through to security, which is where Frank found me — wait, no, Frank went into electrical and found the body with Diana.

Look at the timeline carefully: Eve confirms Diana was in upper engine at tick 2 heading to medbay. But I was in medbay and I did not see Diana there — she must have passed through quickly to electrical. When I arrived in electrical at tick 5, Diana was already standing over Alice's body, exactly as Frank described when he arrived.

Diana is now trying to flip the accusation onto me because both Frank and I independently place her at the scene with the body. Her claim that she "saw Bob leaving electrical toward security" is fabricated — if that were true, Frank coming FROM security would have seen me, and he explicitly said he saw no one on his route.

My vote is Diana. Frank's account and mine line up; hers doesn't.

Okay, this is important. I was in security this whole tick after coming from navigation. At tick 7, I personally watched Bob enter security FROM electrical. That directly contradicts Bob's story.

Bob just told us he went medbay -> electrical, found Diana with the body, and then moved to security. That actually MATCHES what I saw — Bob coming from electrical into security. But it also matches what Diana said: that she saw Bob leaving electrical toward security.

The real problem is Frank's story. Frank claimed he came from weapons through security into electrical and saw no one on his route. But Bob was moving through security around that same time, and I was sitting in security. Frank should have seen at least one of us if he actually came that way.

Also, Frank said "Diana was already in the room with the body" when he arrived — which is consistent with Diana being the reporter-in-waiting, not the killer. A killer usually wouldn't just stand there.

Diana's story holds up: she saw Bob leaving electrical toward security, and I confirm Bob came into security from electrical. Bob had means and opportunity in electrical. Frank's "clean route" claim is suspicious because he didn't mention seeing me in security at all.

I'm torn between Bob and Frank, but Bob being in electrical at the time of death with Alice, then fleeing to security, fits the kill pattern. My vote is Bob.

Wait — I need to clarify something important. Charlie just said he was in security the whole tick and watched Bob enter security from electrical at tick 7. But I came through security on my way to electrical, and I did NOT see Charlie there. That's a real contradiction.

Let me restate my route clearly: weapons -> security -> electrical. I passed through security and saw no one. Then I entered electrical and found Diana standing over Alice's body — that's when I reported.

So either Charlie is lying about being in security, or our timing didn't overlap the way he's claiming. If Charlie was truly sitting in security the whole time, he would have seen ME pass through too — but he conveniently only mentions Bob.

Here's what I think is happening: Diana was caught at the body. Now Diana, Bob, and Charlie are all pointing fingers in different directions to muddy the waters. Diana says Bob did it. Bob says Diana did it. Charlie backs Diana and accuses me or Bob.

The cleanest fact remains: Diana was alone with Alice's body when I walked in. Diana claims she saw Bob leaving toward security — but I came FROM security and saw no Bob and no Charlie. Bob says he arrived AFTER Diana was already standing over the body, which matches what I saw.

My vote is leaning Diana. Charlie's story about being in security doesn't match my experience walking through it.

I've already given my route and what I saw of Diana, so let me focus on analyzing what's been said since.

There are now two big contradictions on the table:

1. Frank says he went weapons -> security -> electrical and saw NO ONE in security. Charlie says he was sitting in security the whole tick and saw Bob come in from electrical. If both were truly in security around the same time, they should have seen each other. One of them is lying about being in security.

2. Bob and Diana actually mostly agree on the physical facts — Bob ended up in security coming from electrical, which is exactly what Diana claimed she saw. They just disagree on who arrived at the body first.

The Frank vs Charlie contradiction is the cleanest lead. If Frank actually walked through security, Charlie sitting there should have seen him. Charlie only mentioned Bob — which is suspicious if he was truly stationary there, but also possible if Frank passed through at a different sub-tick.

Honestly, the person with the weakest alibi here is whoever was in electrical at time of death. Bob admits being in electrical. Diana admits being in electrical. Frank admits walking INTO electrical. All three had access.

I'm leaning toward Bob or Frank over Diana — Diana's story is corroborated by Charlie's sighting of Bob entering security from electrical. That's external confirmation. Frank's "I saw no one" through a security room that Charlie claims to have been sitting in is the biggest red flag for me right now.

I want to hear Charlie or someone clarify the security timing before I lock in a vote.

Exactly. Eve, your breakdown is spot on. I'm sticking to my original story because everything else that's come to light actually supports it. 

Bob just admitted to the exact route I said he took: he was in electrical, and then he left for security. Charlie independently confirmed seeing Bob enter security from electrical. The only thing Bob is changing is the timing, trying to claim I was already over the body to save his own skin. If I had just killed Alice, why would I be standing around the body waiting for both Bob and Frank to walk in? That makes no sense.

I walked into electrical right after Bob killed Alice. He fled to security, which Charlie confirms, and I was left frozen at the scene right as Frank walked in. Bob is the one who had the opportunity and was seen fleeing the exact scene of the crime by two different people. We have to vote Bob.

Bob

Alright, listen carefully because my actual observations are critical here.

My route was medbay -> electrical. I arrived in electrical at tick 5, and Diana was ALREADY there standing over Alice's body. I did not see Alice alive in medbay — Diana's claim that Alice walked into electrical "just ahead of her" while she followed doesn't match what I saw at all. When I got to electrical, Alice was dead and Diana was standing there.

After seeing that, yes, I moved to security — which is where Charlie saw me coming in from electrical, and where Frank later arrived to call us all to the meeting. Charlie's sighting of me leaving electrical toward security is TRUE — but it happened AFTER I found Diana with the body, not because I killed Alice and fled.

Now here's the key thing everyone is missing: Diana is using Charlie's confirmation of my movement as "proof" I'm the killer, but Charlie's sighting only confirms I went electrical -> security. It does NOT confirm WHO arrived in electrical first. Only Diana and I know that, and we're saying opposite things.

So who do you believe? Consider: Diana was ALONE with the body when I walked in, AND alone with the body when Frank walked in. That's two independent witnesses placing her at the scene with the corpse. She's the common denominator.

As for the Frank/Charlie security contradiction — that's worth examining, but it could just be sub-tick timing. The much bigger evidence is Diana standing over Alice's body when TWO separate people walked in.

My vote is Diana.

As the last speaker, let me lay out what I actually know for certain versus what's contested.

What I directly witnessed: I was in security at tick 7, having come from navigation. At tick 7, I saw Bob enter security from electrical. That is a fact — Bob himself now confirms this movement.

Now, on the Frank contradiction: Frank claims he walked through security and saw no one. I was sitting right there. If Frank truly came weapons -> security -> electrical, he should have seen me. He didn't mention me at all in his original speech — he only brought up the contradiction AFTER I called it out. That's a tell. A truthful person retracing their steps would have said "I passed through security and saw Charlie" from the start.

On Bob vs Diana: Bob's story has a real problem. He says he arrived in electrical and Diana was already standing over the body. But Diana says she saw Bob LEAVING electrical as she arrived. The physical movement I witnessed — Bob coming from electrical to security — is consistent with BOTH versions. It doesn't prove who killed Alice.

But here's what tips it for me: Frank's route is the one that doesn't add up. He claims a clean pass through security where I was clearly present. That's a fabricated alibi. Frank could have killed Alice in electrical, then "discovered" the body to control the narrative and pin it on whoever was nearby — Diana.

My vote is Frank.

I found Eve's body in navigation. My route this round was oxygen, upper engine, lower engine, storage, then navigation where I found her. The only player I saw the whole round was Diana in electrical at the start. Since Frank was ejected last meeting and turned out to be... well, we still lost Alice, Eve, and Frank now — that leaves me, Charlie, and Diana alive. One of Charlie or Diana is the Duck. I didn't see Charlie at all this round, and Diana was in electrical which is reasonably close to navigation via cafeteria or storage routes. I'd like to hear both their movements carefully.

Bob, you might be mixing up rounds because I definitely didn't start in electrical this time. My actual route was lower engine, up through cafeteria, and then over to weapons where I've been doing the asteroids task. I was nowhere near navigation at any point. 

The most alarming thing here is Charlie. Neither of us has seen Charlie all round. If you were covering the left and bottom, and I was moving through the middle to the top right, Charlie must have been the one lurking around navigation. He's completely unaccounted for. Let's hear what Charlie's excuse is, but I'm very confident Charlie is the Duck who killed Eve.

Hold on, both of you have inconsistencies I need to address.

My route this round was: medbay, electrical, security, back to electrical, medbay, cafeteria, then oxygen where I was doing Clean O2 Filter when the meeting was called. I was doing tasks the whole time.

Critically — Bob, I saw you at tick 7 in security. That directly contradicts your claimed route of "oxygen, upper engine, lower engine, storage, navigation." Security isn't on that path at all. You're lying about your route.

Diana, I didn't see you this round, but your route (lower engine → cafeteria → weapons) is at least geographically coherent and doesn't pass through navigation.

Bob, you reported the body in navigation, and your stated route conveniently puts you there last — but you were actually in security when I saw you, which is right next to navigation. You're the one with a false alibi and proximity to the kill.

I'm voting Bob.

Charlie, that's a flat-out lie. I was never in security this round — not at tick 7, not at any point. My route was oxygen, upper engine, lower engine, storage, navigation. Security isn't even on that path, and I have no reason to detour there. You're fabricating a sighting to deflect.

And notice what you just did: you accused me of a false alibi, but the "evidence" is something only you claim to have seen, with no one to corroborate. Meanwhile, Diana's route (lower engine → cafeteria → weapons) doesn't go near navigation, and mine ends at navigation because that's where I found Eve's body and reported it — which a Duck would not do.

Your own claimed route is also suspicious: medbay → electrical → security → electrical → medbay → cafeteria → oxygen. That's a lot of backtracking and it covers nearly the whole middle of the map, including paths adjacent to navigation via security. Security connects to navigation directly. You had the means and opportunity.

I'm voting Charlie. Diana, I'd urge you to do the same — Charlie's lie about seeing me in security is the tell.

Bob makes a completely logical point here. Charlie, your claimed route makes absolutely zero sense for someone actually doing tasks. Pacing back and forth—medbay, electrical, security, back to electrical, back to medbay? That’s not a task route; that’s someone patrolling the middle of the ship looking for an isolated target. 

Furthermore, as Bob pointed out, security is a direct corridor away from navigation. You had the perfect positioning to slip down, kill Eve, and then retreat. Now that Bob found the body and the pressure is on, you're fabricating a fake sighting of him in security to set up a counter-accusation. A Duck self-reporting is risky when there's only three of us left, so I believe Bob here. 

I'm voting with Bob. Charlie, you've been caught.

I'll be direct because this is do-or-die.

I am a Goose. My route was task-driven: medbay had a task, electrical had a task, security had a task — that's why I went there. I backtracked through electrical and medbay because those are the connecting rooms to get from security back up to cafeteria and oxygen. That's not "patrolling," that's the actual map layout.

I saw Bob in security at tick 7. I'm not fabricating it. Bob's claimed route — oxygen, upper engine, lower engine, storage, navigation — does NOT include security. But here's the key thing: security is directly adjacent to navigation. If Bob was in security at tick 7 and is lying about it, he had the perfect path to navigation to kill Eve and then "discover" the body.

Diana, think about this carefully: Bob is the one who reported. Bob is the one whose stated route conveniently ends at the body. And Bob is the one I caught in a room he claims he never visited. Self-reporting absolutely happens when a Duck wants to control the narrative — which is exactly what's happening now.

If you vote me and I'm telling the truth, Bob kills you next round and Ducks win. If you vote Bob and I'm wrong, we still have each other to figure it out. The math favors voting Bob.

I'm voting Bob.
